body: Drake gave away $1 million with during his 40th birthday party in New York City. The celebration brought together over 400 guests, who got the chance to win cash prizes during a game of Deal or No Deal. The Toronto rapper shared a video highlighting the giveaway (Nov. 8). Powered by.
